Class CannonWave

java.lang.Object
models.base.CannonWave
public class CannonWave extends Object
A sweeping cannon-wave projectile fired from the player's tower.

The wave travels left across the battlefield in discrete steps. At each step a four-frame explosion animation plays, and any enemy inside the blast radius takes damage once per step (tracked via hitUnits). The wave deactivates automatically when it leaves the left screen boundary.

    • CannonWave

      public CannonWave(double startX)
      Constructs a cannon wave starting at the given world X position. Loads the four-frame blast sprite sheet from resources.
      Parameters:
      startX - world X where the wave originates (typically the tower X)

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update()
      Advances the wave by one game-loop frame.

      Each call cycles the blast animation. After four frames the wave steps left by STEP_SIZE and the hit-set is cleared for the new position. Every frame, all enemies within the current blast radius that have not already been hit this step receive damage. The wave becomes inactive when its X coordinate goes below −200.

    • draw

      public void draw(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext gc, double cameraX)
      Draws the current blast frame at the wave's world position, adjusted by the camera offset.
      Parameters:
      gc - the graphics context to draw onto
      cameraX - the current camera X offset
